name: feat.daggerheart-domain-card-damnation-feature
description: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, mark any number of Stress to roll an equal number of d20s, dealing magic damage equal to the total result. If the target is defeated as a result of this attack, all adversaries within Far range of the target mark a Stress.
